dependency_edges.handoff: Simulated annual nest counts feed the logistic shape check.
Cleaned and augmented images feed representation learning.
Encoded features feed three classifier candidates.
CNN positive probabilities feed regional priority.
Dated cleaned images define age-threshold training sets.
Autoencoder test loss supplies one maintenance curve.
CNN test accuracy supplies the other maintenance curve.
Classifier correctness conditions the eradication proxy correction.
Nest-growth and spatial behavior motivate the monitoring ratios.
Spread maps feed public threat communication.
Update intervals feed agency maintenance advice.
Three ratios and K feed eradication monitoring advice.
